fields.notes: Digital MAC/NWK/APS/security logic is scan-testable; the AES-128 CCM* engine uses standard scan with secure-test isolation of the key registers. The RF macro uses analog/RF production test (PER, EVM) rather than scan.
fields.secure_test_isolation: Key/frame-counter registers isolated from scan to prevent key leakage during test.

extraction_hints: Look for scan / DFT / BIST / JTAG sections.
